<h1>Clock Division</h1>

## Purpose

Set each sequencer's **clock division**: how the incoming MIDI clock maps
to step duration. Speed (FULL / HALF / QUARTER) and division type
(TRIPLETS / SIXTEENTHS / DOTTED) combine into one of nine divisions.

## Interaction

One column per sequencer (LHS cols 1–7 = sequencers 1–7, RHS cols 1–7 = sequencers
9–15; col 8 on each side is reserved/legend). Within a column: rows 8–6
are the speed stack, rows 3–1 the division stack, rows 4–5 always dark.
Active cells light in the sequencer's own colour; a pending change (pressed
but not yet applied) **blinks** until the swap lands. The swap is not
bar-quantised: it waits for the tick where the current and target division
counters read the same value, so the blink can be short or long depending
on which two divisions are involved.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press row 8 / 7 / 6 | LP grid | Set target speed FULL / HALF / QUARTER (applies on the next division coincidence) | none |
| Press row 3 / 2 / 1 | LP grid | Set target division TRIPLETS / SIXTEENTHS / DOTTED (applies on the next division coincidence) | none |
| Press the already-active cell | LP grid | No-op | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO | LP grid | **No-op**: deliberately excluded from reset/randomise | any |

> Either player's LHS edits sequencers 1–7 and either player's RHS edits sequencers
> 9–15. The view is shared.
